caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with four drawers, each featuring two oval-shaped, brass-colored handles. The chest is reddish-brown with visible wood grain patterns and has a polished surface. The two front vertical columns on each side of the chest are intricately carved in a twisted, spiral pattern. The legs of the chest are slender and taper to points at the bottom. The base of the chest has a gently curved, scalloped edge. The background is a plain beige or off-white color with some faint stains or spots visible in the upper right area. In the lower left corner, the name "A. Johnson" is printed in small letters.
title: Chest of Drawers
